youtube_master.title: Darius: How a Street Orphan Became the Hand of Noxus | League of Legends Lore

script.narration: In the harsh lands of Noxus, strength is the only currency that matters.
script.image_prompt: vast dark empire capital at dusk, black iron fortress towers, crimson banners in the wind, armored legions marching on a stone road

script.narration: And no one embodies that law more completely than the man they call the Hand of Noxus.
script.image_prompt: {darius} seen from behind on a cliff, axe resting on his shoulder, burning battlefield below

script.narration: But before the axe, before the legend, there was only a hungry boy in a conquered city.
script.image_prompt: {darius_young} alone in a muddy war-torn medieval city street, smoke and ruined houses, cold blue morning light

script.narration: Darius grew up on the streets of Basilich, a city Noxus had taken by force.
script.image_prompt: conquered walled port city, occupying soldiers with red banners at the gates, starving townsfolk, overcast sky

script.narration: He learned early that mercy was a luxury, and that only those who fought back survived.
script.image_prompt: {darius_young} standing defiantly in a dark alley holding a wooden stick, protecting a smaller child, dramatic shadows

script.narration: When he finally joined the legions, he did not fight for glory. He fought for an idea.
script.image_prompt: young recruit in plain dark armor taking an oath before a red war banner, rows of recruits, torchlight

script.narration: Noxus promised that anyone, no matter where they were born, could rise through strength alone.
script.image_prompt: {darius} climbing a mountain of shields and broken weapons toward a glowing throne, epic scale

script.narration: Darius believed that promise with his whole heart, and he would enforce it with his whole blade.
script.image_prompt: close-up of {darius}, determined expression, ember sparks, firelight reflected on dark steel

script.narration: And as you'll see, that belief would make him the most feared commander in all of Runeterra.
script.image_prompt: {darius} raising his axe in front of a massive army, storm clouds, red lightning, epic wide shot
